summary: Skyline Bankshares, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on August 21, 2026, reporting an Item 8.01 other event: a semi-annual cash dividend of $0.32 per share declared by the board on August 18, 2026, payable September 21, 2026 to holders of record September 11, 2026. The declaration marks an 18.52% increase over the $0.27 per share paid in the third quarter of 2025. The OTC QX-listed bank holding company for Skyline National Bank, operating 28 branches across Virginia, North Carolina, and Tennessee, issued the accompanying press release as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation transaction, advisor, or deal terms are present; this is a routine capital-return announcement rather than a special situation.
